release_name: Schedule Reconciliation — 2 further time changes after parser fix
notes: Re-checked the reconciliation after fixing two parser defects: time ranges ('07h00 a 18h ... exposition') were being read as two separate Masses, and Masses named at an off-site location were attributed to the wrong church. Replaced the +/-90min pairing rule with a structural one (exactly one corpus Mass and one site Mass on the same day = unambiguous change, whatever the gap). Found and applied 2 more corrections, including Immaculee-Conception Friday 06:30 -> 17:00, an 11-hour move the first pass missed. 8 time corrections total.
